newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CBA corrects computer transactions glitch.
newsitem.headline: CBA corrects computer transactions glitch.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) said on Thursday it had corrected a computer fault which processed 300,000 transactions twice on Tuesday evening.
The fault had the effect of doubling the amount of every deposit or withdrawal or transfer for those 300,000 transactions, CBA spokeswoman Lyndell Fraser told Reuters.
"We had a problem with our direct entry processing system on Tuesday night and 300,000 transactions were processed twice," Fraser said.
"They were corrected last night," she said.
CBA was disappointed with the computer glitch, she said, but added that the 300,000 transactions affected represented a small fraction of the more than a billion transactions it conducted annually.
